passage: The 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami led many nations to invest in warning systems that combine seafloor pressure ______ and computer models to estimate a wave's arrival time within minutes.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The blank lists three items: seafloor pressure sensors, coastal tide gauges and computer models.
Items in a simple list are separated by commas.
Semicolons are for lists whose items contain commas; a colon would wrongly introduce the second item; missing commas merge two items.
key: In a simple series, use commas between items.
